# The Twist Bar Locs & Naturals

> Loc and natural hair salon in North Charleston, South Carolina, owned by stylist Tia Murray. Loc retwists, starter and insta locs, micro locs, interlocking, loc extensions, a 3-month loc repair program ("Loc Rescue"), loc color, twists and natural styles. By appointment only, booked on Booksy. Motto: "Get Twisted!!!"

## Quick facts
- Name: The Twist Bar Locs & Naturals
- Owner and stylist: Tia Murray
- Address: 4135 Rivers Ave, Unit A, North Charleston, SC 29418
- Phone: (843) 478-3655
- Booking (live): https://booksy.com/en-us/162900_the-twist-bar-locs-naturals_braids-locs_134778_charleston
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/get_twistedat_tb/ (@get_twistedat_tb)
- Hours (Booksy): Tuesday 9 AM-7 PM, Wednesday 9 AM-7 PM, Thursday 9 AM-9 PM, Friday 9 AM-9 PM, Saturday 7 AM-3 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Policies: No walk-ins. No waiting area. Payment and cancellation policy is shown on Booksy at booking.
- Experience: 15+ years in natural hair.
- Ratings (checked 28 Sep 2026): Booksy 4.9 from 308 reviews (290 five-star); Google 4.6 from 56 reviews.
- In her words: "Our goal is for you to love your natural!! Healthy happy hair is our business. Get Twisted!!!"

## Popular services and starting prices (Booksy, 28 Sep 2026; "+" means starting at)
- Consultation: $25, 30 min. Micro loc install consultation: $25, 30 min.
- ReTwist: $83+, 1h 45m. Retwist & basic style (3-part shampoo, deep condition, retwist, basic style): $95+, 1h 45m.
- Kids retwist (ages 5-12): $75, 2h 10m.
- Starter locs: 3-5 in $145 (2h 30m); 6-10 in $185 (2h 45m); 12 in & up $225+ (3h).
- Insta locs: $400, 4h 40m.
- Micro loc starter: $700, 12h 30m. Micro loc retightening (on schedule): $150, 3h 15m.
- Interlock start: $375, 5h 45m. Interlock retightening (3-6 in, 5 weeks): $135+, 3h 30m.
- Loc extensions (5-16 in, hair included): $600+, 12h 30m. Loc extension touchup: $125+, 2h 30m. Loc reattachment: $400, 5h 30m.
- Loc Rescue, "I messed up. Can you save my locs?" (3-month repair regimen): $200+.
- "I need everything done" (loc detox, scalp detox shampoo, deep condition or hot oil, retwist, any style, plus loc sock and a bottle of the salon's own signature twist oil): $250, 2h 30m.
- Color: $75 (1h). Loc tip color: $65 (1h). Grey coverage: $40. Color & start 12 in+: $300+ (3h 30m).
- Twists: Mini twist $125; Fluffy twist (hair included) $165; TB Twist (short) $185; Nubian twist (hair included) $200; Spring twist (hair included) $200; Natural two strand twist (human hair) $240.
- Natural hair: Natural style $85; Twist out $50; Flat twist out $55; Rod set $90; Big chop $30; Trim $20; Shampoo & condition $35; Deep condition $10; Hot oil treatment $10; Protein treatment $20.

## Loyalty ("Twist Bar Family")
- Birthday: loyal clients of 2+ years get 50% off on their birthday.
- Silver member: elders who have been clients 1+ year get 10% off. "We must respect our elders."
- Gold member: clients of 3+ years get 10% off.
- Gift cards are available on Booksy.
